conviction_note: The Q3 numbers are new: nothing was pre-released and Zalando filed no ad-hoc. The FY guide could be narrowed, so abs_move is set at 7.5 on the European new-numbers and guidance base. The counterparty proxies split: Adidas Europe -4% in a 'high inventory, heavy promotion' market and UBS's weather and sportswear cut against Boozt +16% cc with favourable September weather. With a 21% 20-day run-up that has no fundamental catalyst, and a name that has sold off on most recent prints, p_up sits only slightly below 50 at 47. Findings sum -0.5 against a scaled -0.45; the two agree because the evidence is balanced.

Q3 2026 publication date announced (3 Nov 2026); no ad-hoc / Prognoseanpassung filed since the Q2 release according to the EQS-News issuer archive

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue around consensus EUR 3.15bn (+4% y/y), adj. EBIT around EUR 100m against EUR 96.3m last year. Slight downside lean on promotional intensity and sportswear, offset by Boozt-type September strength. Unknown, roughly balanced.

FY GMV/revenue range may be narrowed again, toward ~12-14%, and adj. EBIT reiterated or narrowed around the EUR 700m midpoint. A cut to the low end is the larger risk, but no ad-hoc was filed, which argues against a material deviation. Direction unknown, slight negative lean.
October / AW26 commentary. Boozt flagged that September weather front-loaded AW26, which could make October look softer. Unknown.
Logistics transition after the Erfurt closure (planned end of September 2026), ABOUT YOU synergies, B2B margin. Unknown.

findings.finding: Adidas' Q3 2026 release (29 Oct) shows currency-neutral Europe sales down 4% to EUR 2.24bn, flat footwear 'in a market characterised by high inventories and heavy promotions', and Europe wholesale weak. This is a counterparty read-through to Zalando's Q3 sportswear GMV and gross margin, partly diluted because Adidas also blamed a SAP migration that shifted deliveries into Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: GMV, revenue (-2%) and adj. EBIT (-5%) missed consensus and the stock fell as much as 17% intraday on 4 Aug (Admirals preview). Misses on the quarter have been punished hard.
findings.original_quote: le calzature sono rimaste stabili a causa di un approccio prudente verso il canale wholesale in un mercato caratterizzato da scorte elevate e forti promozioni ... In calo invece l'Europa (-4%), penalizzata anche dalla migrazione del sistema SAP (Italian source: footwear flat because of a cautious approach to wholesale in a market marked by high inventories and heavy promotions; Europe down 4%, also hit by the SAP migration)
findings.why_not_priced: Zalando rose 2.6% on 29 Oct, the Adidas release day, and has run up 21% in 20 sessions. If the market had transmitted 'heavy promotions in European sportswear' into Zalando's Q3 margin, the stock would have faded into the print rather than making new highs. But the read-through is a proxy and the SAP component is Adidas-specific, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: UBS (13 Oct) cited weaker sportswear and footwear demand for Zalando's Q3 (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/zalando-aktie-ubs-hebt-ziel-fuer-die-zalando-aktie-von-35-00-auf-33-50-euro-an/70362785). H&M reported Western Europe -1% for Jun-Aug on weak spending and heavy promotions (https://www.retaildetail.eu/news/fashion/hm-group-flatlines-this-summer/, snippet only).

findings.finding: Boozt, the Nordic online fashion peer with the same Jul-Sep quarter, pre-released Q3 2026 growth of 16% constant currency with double-digit growth in all categories and major markets, adj. EBIT margin ~5.5% (4.0%), and a raised FY guide. It said 'Favorable weather conditions in September may have front-loaded the AW26 trading'. That is a direct counterparty read against the weather-headwind thesis for European online fashion in September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 GMV/revenue miss: down as much as 17% intraday. Q3 2024: Zalando pre-released a raise by ad-hoc and the stock rose (EQS ad-hoc 2024). Upside surprises on the quarter have historically been rewarded.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Zalando rose 3.8% on 30 Sept, two sessions after the release, and kept climbing through October. Boozt is Nordic-only and has been outgrowing the market, and Zalando's Nordic share of GMV is a minority, so the transmission is narrow. It is sized below the broader Adidas and H&M European read.
findings.independence: H&M said 'In July and August we saw sales pick up, with even stronger sales development in September' (https://fashionunited.com/news/business/hennes-mauritz-surprises-with-significant-profit-increase-in-third-quarter/2026092474808, snippet only).

findings.finding: UBS (Yashraj Rajani) cut its Zalando target from EUR 35.00 to EUR 33.50 on 13 Oct (Buy kept) and lowered adj. EBIT estimates for 2026-28, citing expected Q3 burdens from weather effects and weaker demand for sportswear and sports shoes. JPMorgan (Neutral) pencilled ~EUR 101m Q3 operating profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same line as above: the Q2 miss drew -13% to -17%.
findings.original_quote: Die UBS begründete ihr niedrigeres Ziel mit erwarteten Belastungen im dritten Quartal durch Wettereffekte und eine schwächere Nachfrage nach Sportbekleidung und -schuhen (UBS justified its lower target with expected Q3 burdens from weather effects and weaker demand for sportswear and sports shoes)
findings.why_not_priced: It is wire copy and largely priced. What is not obviously priced is that the stock rose about 10% after the cut while estimates were trimmed, so the price has moved away from the sell-side's lowered Q3 view. Sized small because Boozt contradicts the weather half.
findings.independence: Adidas Europe -4% (finding 1, a different document); contradicted on weather by Boozt (finding 2).

findings.finding: Zalando filed no ad-hoc / Prognoseanpassung between the Q2 release and the print, although Q3 closed on 30 Sept and Zalando used exactly that channel in Oct 2024 to pre-release a Q3 outlook raise. Under MAR Art. 17 this argues against a large deviation from the guide in either direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance changes moved the stock hard: the Q2 2026 'lower half' refinement drew -13%, and the Q3 2024 ad-hoc raise drew a positive reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: It is symmetric, so it carries no sign. It caps the tail of a guide change rather than shifting the direction. Q2 missed consensus by 2-5% without an ad-hoc, so the threshold is high and a modest narrowing remains possible.
findings.independence: The precedent is in the EQS archive itself (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/zalando-se-zalando-se-increases-outlook-for-the-financial-year-2024-after-strong-q3-2024/f5d7fb43-6cae-4b46-993a-66183e87b0b3_en).

findings.finding: Supervisory board member Anders Holch Povlsen, via the closely associated Aktieselskabet af 1.2.2017, bought Zalando shares in dozens of Directors' Dealings filings around EUR 24.90 during Q3 (filed 5-13 Aug 2026), after the Q2 sell-off.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history for insider buying on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for nearly three months and the stock fell to EUR 21.48 in September after it, so it is mostly priced. What is left is a board insider buying inside the quarter now being reported, a small positive.

findings.finding: Zalando's Erfurt logistics centre (about 2,700 staff, the oldest node in its network) was set to close at the end of September 2026 as part of the post-ABOUT YOU network consolidation, with a new site in Giessen. The logistics benefits management cited for H2 EBIT confidence therefore come after a Q3 that carried the transition.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No isolated history. Restructuring is normally excluded from adj. EBIT.
findings.original_quote: Zalando schließt Standort Erfurt mit 2.700 Beschäftigen (Zalando closes its Erfurt site with 2,700 employees)
findings.why_not_priced: Known since January and inside what the company guided, so it is sized near 0. Any double-running cost would sit in adj. EBIT only if it is not classed as restructuring, which is unverified.

outside_window.finding: Boozt publishes its full Q3 2026 report on 3 Nov, the same day, so it is not informative before the Zalando open; ASOS and Next updates later in November

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes median 9.0% against 2.3%): a Q3 narrowing of the FY range is plausible and the numbers are not pre-released, so abs_move_pct rose from 7.0 to 7.5
'reported_quarter findings went 4 of 14 on sign': every directional finding here lands on the reported quarter, so p_up moved toward 50, from 46 to 47
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series': Boozt (Nordic only) was trimmed from +0.5 to +0.4 against the broader European Adidas and H&M read
'Coverage tells you which regime': DAX name with 26-29 analysts, so all sizes stay small; no change beyond the above
